references.text: Parallel text where the Lord gives Moses exactly the same command not to fear Og, king of Bashan, with the same promise of victory
Describes the fulfillment of the promise that God gave Og into Israel's hand, just as he had done with Sihon
Refers to the victory over Sihon, king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, which is the pattern for what God will do with Og
God's promise to give Sihon into Israel's hand, the earlier victory referred to as an example
Moses reminds the people that the Lord will deal with their enemies as he dealt with Sihon and Og, kings of the Amorites
Rahab mentions the victory over Sihon and Og as an example of God's mighty deeds
The psalm praises God for striking down Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan
A song of thanksgiving that mentions the victory over Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan
God's command 'Do not fear' and his promise of presence and help
Moses and Joshua encourage the people not to fear the people in the land, for the Lord is with them
